name: Stunning Note
body:
School enchantment (compulsion) [mind-affecting, sonic] ; Level bard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 move action
Components V

EFFECT

Range 50 ft.
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw Fortitude negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You stun a creature for 1 round with a shrieking note.
